about: The organisations github-pt reads: GitHub organisations (not people) of Portuguese startups, companies, public bodies, universities and open-source projects. Each was verified on 18 November 2026 (verified_at) from the organisation's own public profile on GitHub's REST API (GET /orgs/{login}: location and blog fields, read 18 November 2026) and, where noted, the company's own site. Verified means: the profile's location names Portugal or a Portuguese place, or its blog is the organisation's own .pt site, or the company's own site shows a Portuguese office and links the organisation. Checked by an agent, not reviewed by a person. Proposal: re-verify every 90 days. Organisations that did not meet the test were left out: Talkdesk (profile location San Francisco), Feedzai (no location; its site shows none), Unbabel and Aptoide (no location), Whitesmith (United Kingdom), OutSystems (no location; site shows Boston).
